content: Wi u win tii ɡɔwɑ, win tiin ɑrufɑɑniwɑ u kɑsu. U rɑ mɔru sewɑ bɑ̀ n kĩ bu nùn bwisi kɛ̃.
Gɑri bɔkɔ u ku rɑ bwisi kɑ̃, mɑ n kun mɔ u win ɡɑri bɑkɑru sɔ̃ɔsi.
Nuku kɔ̃suru tɑ rɑ kɑ ɡɛndu nɛwɑ, kpɑ bɛɛrɛ sɑriru tu kɑ sekuru nɑ.
Tɔnun ɡɑri yi sɛ̃wɑ nɡe dɑɑ tèn nim mu duku, ɑdɑmɑ bwisi yi sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe nim mɛ mu yɑrimɔ sɑɑ bwiɑn di.
N ǹ weenɛ ɑ yɔ̃rɑ toron biruɔ, kpɑ ɑ ɡemɡii nùn win ɡem birɑ.
Gɑri bɔkɔn ɡɑri yi rɑ kɑ sikirinɔsu nɛwɑ, kpɑ win nɔɔ ɡu kɑ soonɑɑ nɑ.
Gɑri bɔkɔn ɡɑriyɑ yi rɑ nùn yinɑ mwɛ, kpɑ yu nùn kɑm ko.
Dɔmɛn ɡɑri yi sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe dĩɑ duronu ni tɔmbɑ kɑtɑ mɔ̀ bɑ mwɛɛmɔ.
Wi u rɑ sɔmburu ɑtɑfiiru ko, kɑ wi u tu sɑnkumɔ, be kpuro tiɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe ɡbɑ̃rɑ dɑmɡiru. Gemɡii ù n dukɑ dɑ mi, u ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ.
Gobiɡii u rɑ win dukiɑ ɡɑrisiwɑ nɡe ɡbɑ̃rɑ te tɑ dɑm mɔ, domi u tɑmɑɑ yiyɑ yi nùn kɔ̃su.
Tii suɑbu bu rɑ kɑ tɔnu kɑm kobu nɑɑwɛwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ tii kɑwɑbu bu rɑ dewɑ bu tɔnu bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃.
Wi u ku rɑ ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑki u sere wisi, yɑ win ɡɑri bɑkɑru sɔ̃ɔsimɔwɑ. Mɛyɑ u mɑɑ tii sekuru dokemɔwɑ.
Tɔnu ù n kĩ u n wɑ̃ɑ, yɑ rɑ nùn dɑm kɛ̃ win bɑrɑru sɔɔ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u kun yĩiyɔbu mɔ, wɑrɑ koo kpĩ u nùn dɑm kɛ̃.
Bwisiɡii u rɑ kɑ̃wɑ u yɛ̃ru sosi. Lɑɑkɑriɡii u rɑ mɑɑ kɑ̃wɑ u sɔ̃ɔsiru wɑ.
Kɛ̃nu nu rɑ tɔnu swɛɛ kuewɑ, kpɑ nu de yɛ̃ro u dɑmɡibun nɔnu ɡeu wɑ.
Siribu sɔɔ wi u ɡbiɑ u ɡɑri ɡeruɑ, yi rɑ n ɡinɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ dee dee, sere win yibɛrɛ ù n mɑɑ wiɡii ɡeruɑ.
Tɛtɛ dumɑ yɑ rɑ sɔ̃ɔsi wi u ɡem mɔ, kpɑ sɑnnɔsu su kpe, kpɑ yu dɑmɡibu yɑkiɑnɑ.
À n wunɛn bɔrɔ torɑri, yɑ sɛ̃ ɑ kɑ nùn susi n kere ɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ dɑmɡiru surɑ. Ì n mɑɑ sɑnnɑ, i kɑ dorɑ, yen sɛ̃sɔ ɡɑ kpɑ̃ ɡɑ kere dii te bɑ kɑ kɔkɔrɔ dɑmɡiɑ kɛnuɑn dubu.
Tɔnun ɡeren ɑreyɑ u ko n kɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
Gɑri yi koo kpĩ yi tɔnu ɡo. Yi koo mɑɑ kpĩ yi nùn wɑ̃ɑru wɛ̃. Wi u rɑ ɡɑri sɑɑri u koo yin ɑre wɑ.
Wi u kurɔ wɑ u ɡɑ̃ɑ ɡeenu wɑwɑ. Gusunɔn duromɑ.
Sɑ̃ɑro u rɑ ɡɑri ɡerewɑ kɑ wɔnwɔndu, ɑdɑmɑ ɡobiɡii u rɑ ɡerewɑ kɑ dɑm.
Bɔrɔ dɑbinu nu koo kpĩ nu kɑ tɔnu nɔni swɑ̃ɑru nɑɑwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ bɔrɔ ɡoo u mɛro bisi kere.
